The blue pass-through (rope row 26, tip 40→46, player 24-29) also did not make the blue legend hollow. That is:
- Red pass (player 18-23, topmost): hollow.
- Green pass (player 30-35): no.
- Blue pass (player 24-29): no.
So the hollow is tied to the player being at the topmost position (rows 18-23) — or to the red block being special.
Hmm, wait, actually — hold on. Maybe the hollow red isn't about the player's position. Let me reconsider: the hollow red appeared at transition 8. What was special about transition 8 compared to 14/17?
- T8: rope 40→46, row 20.
- T14: rope 40→46, row 32.
- T17: rope 40→46, row 26.
Only the row differs. Row 20 = red's row = topmost.
So the hollow is specific to red/the top.
New idea: maybe the hollow legend indicates "the currently active target," and the game's target sequence is: first red (topmost), then... no wait, green/blue never became active.
Or: the hollow is a "selected" state, and selection happens when the rope is extended to the maximum on the target's row. The target is red first. After red is "confirmed" (by some action), the target becomes green, and so on.
So the flow might be: align + extend to max → the block becomes "selected" (hollow in the legend) → press some action (ACTION7? MOUSE?) to "confirm/collect" → the next block becomes the target.
But when I pressed ACTION7 while red was selected, red became filled again (deselected) — that was a cancel. MOUSE on the red block did nothing.
What other actions are there? UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT/MOUSE/ACTION7. LEFT! I've never pressed LEFT! Maybe LEFT "collects" the selected block (like pulling the rope in toward the player)? Or LEFT moves the player... the player is at col 11-16; LEFT might move the player left (off the board?) or pull the rope.
Actually, in this kind of game, LEFT might be "reel in the rope" and ACTION7 might be "release." Hmm, ACTION7 already retracts the rope.
Let me think about the game from another angle. What if the objective is to pull each block to the left, all the way to the player? The rope passes through the block; when the rope retracts (ACTION7), the block... didn't move. Hmm, but maybe the block only gets pulled when it's "selected" (hollow)?
Test: select red (UP, RIGHT → rope 40→46 row 20), then ACTION7. Previously (T11) that made red filled, and the block didn't move. So no.
Test: select red, then LEFT. Let's try it: currently the player is at 24-29 (rope row 26, tip 46). UP (player 18-23), RIGHT (40→46? no, the tip is already 46!). Wait, the current tip is 46 (after T17). So to select red: UP (rope row 20, tip 46, aligned with red). Did red become hollow just from aligning at tip 46? At T11→T12, when the rope was at row 20 tip 46... no wait, at T11 the rope was at row 20 tip 40 (retracted). Then at T12 it moved to row 26.
Hmm, actually, at T8 the rope was at row 20 tip 46, and red was hollow. At T9 (RIGHT, no impact) it was still hollow. At T11 (ACTION7, 46→40) it became filled. So hollow = (aligned AND tip 46)? Then at T14 (row 32, tip 46, aligned with green) green should have been hollow. It wasn't!
So alignment + max is not sufficient for green. The row matters. Red's row is special.
Could it be that... the hollow red is a "target" indicator, and the target only changes after a successful collection, and the collection requires something I haven't done yet. And the target is always red until it's collected. That would make sense: target = the first uncollected block in the legend order (red). The target is shown as hollow when the rope is aligned + extended (i.e., "in position"). Green/blue never became the target because red was never collected.
So: how do I collect red? While in position (rope row 20, tip 46, red hollow), press... something. I tried MOUSE on the block (nothing) and ACTION7 (deselected). Things I haven't tried: MOUSE on the legend's red icon, MOUSE on the player, LEFT, DOWN/UP while in position.
Let me try MOUSE on the legend's red icon (row 58, col 28) while in position. And LEFT.
Plan: UP (align red, tip 46 → red should become hollow), then MOUSE (58,28). Check the legend + board.
Actually, wait — when I align red at tip 46, will red become hollow again? At T8, yes. Let me do this: UP, then check the legend, then try MOUSE on the legend's red.
Let me batch it: UP, then check.
